summary: Examples of replace: renaming a hostname with groups, commenting lines after or before or between markers, removing lines with ownership, validating Apache ports, short vs long form escaping, and positional or named group backreferences.
questions: How do I comment out all lines after a marker?
How do I replace text between two expressions?
How do I change ListenAddress in sshd_config with replace?
Why do I need double backslashes in short-form replace?
How do I use named groups in replace?

answer_card.title: replace examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.replace:
    path: /etc/hosts
    regexp: '(\s+)old\.host\.name(\s+.*)?$'
    replace: '\1new.host.name\2'
- ansible.builtin.replace:
    path: /etc/apache2/sites-available/default.conf
    after: 'NameVirtualHost [*]'
    regexp: '^(.+)$'
    replace: '# \1'
- ansible.builtin.replace:
    path: /etc/hosts
    after: '(?m)^<VirtualHost [*]>'
    before: '</VirtualHost>'
    regexp: '^(.+)$'
    replace: '# \1'
- ansible.builtin.replace:
    path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
    regexp: '^(ListenAddress[ ]+)[^\n]+$'
    replace: '\g<1>0.0.0.0'
```
Short form `k=v` needs `\\b`; long YAML form uses `\b`.
